end.summary:
Practised placing unit fractions on a number line by splitting 0 to 1 into equal gaps.
Riya identified that fifths require five equal gaps and named the first mark 1/5.
Riya correctly placed 2/5 before the midpoint after reasoning with 2.5 parts.
Riya answered 1/2 and 1/6 in later prompts; teach-back was not passed.
Riya could not show marks on the screen, and had 0 unaided correct attempts out of 2.
end.parentNote: Asha practised dividing the interval from 0 to 1 into equal gaps and naming the marks as fractions. Riya used the idea of sharing a chocolate bar equally and correctly reasoned that 2/5 comes before the midpoint; later, they identified 1/2 and 1/6. They mixed up the number at a middle mark with the fraction label, and this was not clearly corrected by the end. At home, ask Riya to draw a 0–1 line, split it into five equal gaps, and label each mark 1/5, 2/5, 3/5, and 4/5.
